description: (Fêtes / soirées interdites. Bruit/musique après 22h interdit). Beautiful 4 bedroom apt 2 minutes walk from the Louvre and the Seine River. The master bedroom has a king size bed with an ensuite bathroom. The second bedroom has a king size bed .The third bedroom has a queen size bed. The junior bedroom has two single beds. There is a second bathroom with a large italian shower.There is a seperate toilet, the 2 bathrooms do not have toilets . The living room has a sofa-bed that can sleep two.The spaceBeautiful four bedroom apartment right in the center of Paris. Two minutes away by foot from the Louvre and the Seine River. It has been fully refurbished. The master bedroom has a king size bed with an ensuite bathroom. The second bedroom has a king size bed also.The third bedroom has a queen size bed and is adjoining the junior bedroom which has two single beds. There is a second bathroom with a large italian shower.There is a seperate toilet, the 2 bathrooms do not have toilets . The living room has a sofa-bed that can sleep two comfortably if needed.Other things to noteParties are forbidden. Any party will lead to prosecution, eviction and withholding of your security deposit.

enrichment.summary: Four bedrooms list five separate beds; an additional living-room sofa bed is excluded from that count. The listing describes one separate WC and a second bathroom with an Italian shower; photos show shower fixtures in two bathroom views. A lift is advertised, but stair-free access is not established.

issues: The listing does not describe a lift route or the steps between the entrance and apartment.

themes: Guests praise the central location, walkability and access to restaurants, shops and attractions.
Guests describe comfortable, clean and spacious accommodations and praise clear communication and responsive, flexible hosting.
concerns: One guest says the refrigerator is small for a large group’s grocery needs.
